title: Most crypto sectors lagged Bitcoin over past 3 months: Glassnode
summary: Bitcoin fell 26% in three months but outperformed most crypto sectors as Ether dropped 36%, AI tokens fell 48%, and memecoins dipped 56%.

title: Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin goes multichain in new pilot
summary: Ripple is testing RLUSD on layer 2s Optimism, Base, Ink, and Unichain, after the token initially launched on the XRP Ledger and Ethereum in 2024.

title: MetaMask adds Bitcoin support after teasing it 10 months ago
summary: Users can now buy, swap, send, and receive Bitcoin directly within the popular Ethereum-focused wallet, expanding its multichain reach.

title: Over 1 in 20 emails are malicious, warns internet giant Cloudflare
summary: Cloudflare found over 5% of global emails were malicious in 2025, peaking at nearly 10% in November, with more than half of them containing deceptive links.

title: Crypto urges SEC to see the good in blockchain privacy tools
summary: US Securities and Exchange Commission chair Paul Atkins says the agency must find how to allow people to use blockchain privacy tools “without immediately falling under suspicion.”

title: US crypto market structure legislation to advance in early 2026
summary: The Senate Banking Committee delayed crypto market structure hearings until 2026 amid ongoing bipartisan negotiations.

title: Bitcoin to hit new all-time high within 6 months: Grayscale
summary: Grayscale’s 2026 outlook cites institutional demand and clearer US regulation as key catalysts for Bitcoin’s surge in the first half of 2026.

title: Trump to ‘look into’ recently convicted Samurai Wallet co-founder
summary: Trump has already pardoned two crypto heavyweights, Binance founder Changpeng “CZ” Zhao in October and Silk Road founder Ross Ulbricht in January.

title: Bitcoin, altcoins sell-off as Fed chair switch-up, AI bubble fears spook markets
summary: The crypto market corrected as a shake-up in the Trump administration’s Fed chair pick spooked traders, and growing US macroeconomic challenges led investors to risk-off.
